title: Weak Lockout Mechanism
description: Three-question branching assessment of account lockout controls. Item_1 gates the rest: if brute force is not possible, OTP guessing is eliminated. Item_2 and Item_3 are both evaluated when brute force is allowed.

Item_1.question: Does the endpoint allow brute force? (No lockout / rate limiting observed after repeated failed attempts)

Item_2.question: Are security questions easy to guess? (Weak, common, or user-enumerable answers accepted)
Item_2.note: Evaluated regardless of Item_1 verdict. Y = indicator of compromise.

Item_3.question: If brute force is allowed, is OTP code guessing present? (OTP endpoint lacks lockout)
Item_3.note: Only applicable when Item_1 verdict is true. Set to null and skip if Item_1 is false.
